Every order, customer and product here is made up. Change anything: it is your own copy.

ship._title: How do I ship an order?

text._text: Open the order from Orders or the dashboard and press Mark shipped. The shipped date is set to today.

board._title: How does the fulfilment board work?

text._text: Each column is a status. Drag a card to another column, or pick it up with Space and move it with the arrow keys.

create._title: How do I take a new order?

text._text: Go to New order, pick a customer and a product, set the quantity and press Create order. The price and total come from the product.

stock._title: When is a product low on stock?

text._text: When its stock is at or below its reorder level. Low products show on the dashboard; restock them on Products.

cancel._title: Can I undo a cancelled order?

text._text: No. A cancelled order stays cancelled and does not count towards revenue.
